sentences.pinyin: Nǐ tīng de dào wǒ shuōhuà ma?
sentences.scenario: Check your audio at the start of an online lesson.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 你听我 at 00:28; hearing structures recur in the lesson.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ méi tīngdào, qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.
sentences.english_hint: I didn't hear; please say it again.
sentences.scenario: Ask someone to repeat a missed sentence.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill addressing the confusion between 不听 and 没听到 at 09:00.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài shǒujī shàng kàn xīnwén.
sentences.english_hint: I read news on my phone.
sentences.scenario: Explain how you read the news.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of 我在手机看这个 at 04:29.

sentences.scenario: Practice saying where you study Chinese.
sentences.source_note: Explicit supporting drill in the analysis for location before action.

sentences.scenario: Ask a colleague for the source of some news.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill for recurring difficulty identifying who provided information.

sentences.scenario: Practice identifying a colleague as the source.
sentences.source_note: Explicit analysis drill clarifying the teller and receiver.

sentences.english_hint: Who did you hear it from?
sentences.scenario: Ask where someone heard a workplace update.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ shì tīng lǎoshī shuō de.
sentences.english_hint: I heard it from my teacher.
sentences.scenario: Practice naming your teacher as the source.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill simplifying the correction from 讲 to 听 at 25:14.

sentences.chinese: 我今天没有时间看新闻。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān méiyǒu shíjiān kàn xīnwén.
sentences.english_hint: I don't have time to read news today.
sentences.scenario: Explain why you haven't checked the news.
sentences.source_note: Analysis drill building on the learner's successful 没有时间看报纸.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yǒu shíjiān xué Zhōngwén.
sentences.english_hint: I have time to study Chinese today.
sentences.scenario: Say that your schedule allows Chinese study.
sentences.source_note: Explicit analysis drill pairing available time with an action.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yào zuò hěn duō shìqing.
sentences.english_hint: I have many things to do today.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 一定做很多东西 at 15:00 using 要 and 事情.

sentences.chinese: 我们明天真的不用上班吗？
sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān zhēn de bú yòng shàngbān ma?
sentences.english_hint: Do we really not have to work tomorrow?
sentences.scenario: Confirm surprising news about tomorrow's schedule.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of the incomplete work schedule question at 28:00.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ bú tài xiāngxìn zhège xiāoxi.
sentences.english_hint: I don't really believe this news.
sentences.scenario: Express doubt about an unconfirmed update.
sentences.source_note: Recommended vocabulary sentence in the analysis; news reactions were a major lesson topic.

sentences.scenario: Ask about an event you missed while traveling.
sentences.source_note: Question practiced near 37:35–38:18 after the learner mentioned taking a flight.
